title: Amaranth Pilaf with Indonesian Flair
description: A flavorful and nutritious side dish that combines the nutty taste of amaranth with the savory flavors of Indonesian cuisine.
instructions: Rinse the amaranth in a fine-mesh strainer under cold water, and drain well.
In a medium saucepan, heat the pilaf over medium heat.
Add the amaranth and stir to coat with the pilaf.
Add the salt and Indonesian paste, and stir to combine.
Cook for 5 minutes, or until the amaranth is lightly toasted.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the water has been absorbed.
Fluff the amaranth with a fork, and serve hot.
